Options:
  -exec COMMAND  Select the program launcher
  -v  List compiled packages
  -n  Print commands without running them
  -x  Print executed commands
  -race  Enable race detection
  -tags LIST  Set build tags
  -ldflags FLAGS  Pass linker arguments
  -gcflags FLAGS  Pass compiler arguments
  -mod MODE  Set module download mode
  -trimpath  Remove local paths from output
